author: Ralph M. Kaufmann

difficulty_reason: Open window gluing can change the number of complementary regions and create labelled punctures, so the closed Frobenius contraction formula alone does not provide an action. The author defines weights for decorated boundary pieces and punctures and checks every local non-self and self-gluing topology. The new lone-window cases require the projection and Euler compatibility identities, with explicit contractions producing exactly the required Euler and puncture factors.

proof_review.method: Published author proof/core and local context fidelity screening
proof_review.note: Read brane-labelled window/arc and orientation-reversing gluing definitions3-7, full basic Frobenius system/adjoint/projection definitions9-11, bar and dual correlator contractions12-14, full decorating/weight universal correlator formula14-15, and complete new local non-self/self/consecutive-window contraction cases16-18. Select Theorem5.1 as one main discrete action, restricted explicitly to ordinary finite-dimensional Frobenius algebras, a basic brane-label system (higher-intersection algebras zero), commutative closed algebra condition(C), and Euler compatibility(E). The proof invokes C/E on18 although the short theorem statement says only basic; this restriction is authored in Definition4.5 and the case proof, not an invented repair. The action means compatibility of the original correlation functions(4)-(5) with matching-weight open/closed self and non-self window gluings under the supplied Casimir contractions. No independent dg-PROP, general brane propagator, moduli-space action, arbitrary noncommutative closed algebra or geometric string-topology claim counted. Closed contraction and standard bar/Hochschild duality are stated background; all selected new open contraction cases are supplied. Exact selected statement and terminal proof pages rendered and visually inspected; physical headers/native ZIP members and source/license hashes checked. No independent mathematical reproof.

original_metadata.statement_scope: Theorem5.1 restricted to the source basic brane-label system of ordinary finite-dimensional Frobenius algebras with algebra restriction maps, higher-intersection algebras zero, commutative A_empty (C) and Euler compatibility (E), as defined4.1.4 and4.5. For discretely positively weighted brane-labelled arc graphs, original correlators(4)-(5) are compatible with all permitted matching-weight open and closed window gluings, including self and consecutive-window gluing, via the original Casimir contractions. No dg-PROP or moduli-space conclusion, general propagator systems or removal of C/E.
